LESSON: READING 14.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: PLAY- RELATING TO REAL LIFE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes plays interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the characters in a play
2. discuss the various themes in a play
3. appreciate the beauty of performance of a literary text

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 14.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: PLAY- RELATING TO REAL LIFE
This lesson teaches Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the characters in a play
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. discuss the various themes in a play
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the beauty of performance of a literary text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life above.
2. Explain Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 14.4.1 Intensive Reading: Play- Relating to real life important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes plays interesting?
2. Why is it important for an actor to pronounce words correctly and speak audibly in a performance?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the characters in a play
2. discuss the various themes in a play
3. appreciate the beauty of performance of a literary text
